name: sample2
description: Machinum Pipeline sample — JSONL to MD with multi-tool pipeline

scripts.example: mkdir -p vendor && pnpm -C ../../packages/core pack --pack-destination "$(pwd)/vendor" && pnpm -C ../../packages/cli pack --pack-destination "$(pwd)/vendor" && pnpm -C ../../packages/tools pack --pack-destination "$(pwd)/vendor" && pnpm -C ../../packages/waypoint pack --pack-destination "$(pwd)/vendor" && npm install --no-save --no-audit --no-fund file:./vendor/mt-core-0.1.0.tgz file:./vendor/mt-cli-0.1.0.tgz file:./vendor/mt-tools-0.1.0.tgz file:./vendor/mt-waypoint-0.1.0.tgz && mkdir -p md chapters/schema && pnpm run prepare-input && pnpm run runner
scripts.cleanup: rm -rf md/output.md chapters/schema/*.schema.md jsonl/input.jsonl vendor package-lock.json node_modules
